name: Solitaire
tagline: Klondike with undo, on a phone. The file is the tableau.
description:
Works offline. Close it and the tableau is where you left it, inside this copy of the app — the file is the save, no account and no install.

Seven columns, four foundations, draw one or three. Red on black, kings in empty spaces, aces up the foundations. Tap a card and it jumps to the first legal home; tap the home yourself when several fit. Undo, hint, and auto-complete when every card is face-up. Drag a run with a mouse or a thumb.

An unofficial port of js-solitaire by rjanjic. Same Klondike rules; cards drawn in CSS so it fits a phone.
